verdict.rationale: The core client source is publicly readable on GitHub (anyproto/anytype-ts), and the agents toolkit is described as open-source. However, a community user reports the main product ships under a source-available license rather than an open one, and no first-party evidence states an OSI-approved license for the core app or the anytype-heart middleware. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an OSI-approved open license for the core app and middleware, independent confirmation of license terms.
